name: GeoMapApp
product: GeoMapApp by the Marine Geoscience Data System at Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory, Columbia University

evidence.says: The project provides a dedicated Apple silicon DMG for M1 and later, alongside a separate Intel DMG.
The project’s development history dates release 3.7.8 to September 28, 2026.
The project identifies 3.7.8 as the current release and directs users to its platform-specific downloads.

notes: The Apple silicon download link on the official Mac page is named GeoMapApp-3.7.8-Silicon.dmg.

name: ArtRage 4
product: ArtRage 4 by Ambient Design

evidence.says: Ambient Design identifies ArtRage 4 as a discontinued desktop edition.
The vendor lists 4.5.10 as the final ArtRage 4 update, released May 19, 2016.
The vendor specifies Intel Macs only for the ArtRage 4 line.

limitation: Rosetta runtime compatibility was not established.
notes: The final Mac release was Intel-only; Ambient Design replaced this edition with ArtRage 5 in February 2017.

name: Box Notes
product: Box Notes desktop application by Box

evidence.says: Box confirms that it discontinued the standalone Box Notes desktop app and disabled it for existing users on June 15, 2022.

limitation: Box's shutdown notice gives no final Mac version or binary architecture.
notes: Box Notes remains available through the Box website and the Box mobile app.

name: UA Mixer Engine
product: Universal Audio UAD Mixer Engine for Apollo

evidence.says: The Apollo software manual identifies UAD Mixer Engine as a startup background service that handles Apollo's DSP mixer for Console and Console Recall.

notes: The bundle is an Apollo software component.

name: GPlates
product: GPlates desktop by the GPlates project and EarthByte

evidence.says: The project names GPlates 2.5 as the current stable version and offers a macOS arm64 disk image for Big Sur or later.
EarthByte's April 15, 2024 release announcement provides the GPlates 2.5 installers.

name: Roam Research
product: Roam Research desktop by Roam Research

evidence.says: Roam's macOS updater manifest lists version 0.0.43, a November 18, 2026 release date, and both arm64 ZIP and DMG assets.
The live November 25 cask metadata identifies the desktop bundle ID and points its Apple Silicon download to the vendor's version 0.0.43 arm64 DMG.

name: lghub_installer
product: Logitech G HUB macOS installer by Logitech G

evidence.says: Logitech describes its G HUB macOS installer as a separate setup or repair program that exits before users launch G HUB.
Logitech separately identifies the G HUB installer download and the installed G HUB application in its troubleshooting guide.

notes: The scanned bundle is the installer for Logitech G HUB.

name: Slicer 4.11.20210226
product: 3D Slicer by the 3D Slicer community and Kitware

evidence.says: The 5.12.4 stable macOS build is Intel amd64 and the Apple Silicon arm64 column offers only the 5.13.0 preview.
A Slicer contributor cites the project meeting notes confirming that 5.12 stable uses Rosetta on Apple Silicon.

notes: The original 4.11 build is historical. The official 5.13.0 arm64 preview (revision 35475 as of the audit) is marked as potentially incomplete.

name: Greenshot
product: Greenshot for Mac by the Greenshot project, published by Thomas Braun

evidence.says: The official Mac App Store product lists version 1.2.19, dated June 29, 2020, as the latest Mac release.
The published scan of org.getgreenshot.Greenshot 1.2.19 records only x86 for the Mac bundle.
A user reports that Greenshot is running via Rosetta on an M4 Max Mac Studio with macOS Tahoe 26.4.1.

limitation: Rosetta operation is based on a user report, and other macOS versions were not verified.
notes: The project's Windows releases have their own version history.

name: Logitech Gaming Software
product: Logitech Gaming Software (LGS) for Mac by Logitech

evidence.says: Logitech's legacy notice says LGS installation files, download links, and support documentation were scheduled for permanent removal effective October 31, 2026.
Logitech identifies G HUB as LGS's successor for all new devices since 2019 and says all LGS-compatible hardware is out of warranty.

limitation: The final Mac build and its architecture could not be confirmed from the retirement notice.
notes: Keep LGS distinct from G HUB and Logitech Control Center.

name: Hauptwerk
product: Hauptwerk Virtual Pipe Organ by Milan Digital Audio

evidence.says: Milan Digital Audio announced the 9.0.1 update on February 13, 2025.
The official Mac download is Hauptwerk 9.0.1.
The Hauptwerk 9 prerequisites specify a 64-bit Intel Mac executable and Rosetta translation on ARM-based Apple Silicon Macs.
The 9.0.1 release notice specifies that the supported platforms are unchanged and documents Apple Silicon operation under Rosetta.

name: Dashboard
product: Apple Dashboard launcher for the macOS Dashboard widget environment

evidence.says: Apple documents Dashboard as the operating system's built-in widget environment, accessible from Mission Control.
WebKit's issue tracker records removal of Dashboard support in June 2019.

notes: The scanned bundle ID belongs to the launcher for the built-in Dashboard feature.

name: DVIP
product: Datavideo DVIP Network Config for Mac

evidence.says: Datavideo identifies the exact Mac distribution as DVIP Configuration Software 1.1.2 and links it separately from Windows, Android, and iOS.
Apple's store metadata matches bundle ID dvipnetconf and reports version 1.1.2 released October 5, 2018.
The vendor also lists a newer 1.1.6 x86 download without identifying that file as the Mac App Store build.

limitation: The terms of Mac App Store compatibility and architecture of the 1.1.2 executable could not be verified, and the newer x86 download has no confirmed Mac association.

name: SpatialKey Client
product: SpatialKey Client for Mac by SpatialKey, now part of Insurity

evidence.says: The original submission identifies the desktop app as an Electron bundle named SpatialKey Client with identifier com.spatialkey.desktop.
Insurity confirms its acquisition of SpatialKey, the geospatial analytics company for property and casualty insurance.
Insurity documents continued development of the SpatialKey platform without identifying a macOS desktop-client release.

limitation: No current release, binary architecture, or end-of-support notice for the Mac client was found.
notes: The currently marketed SpatialKey platform is described at https://insurity.com/platform/spatialkey.

name: Pixel Starships
product: Pixel Starships by Savy Soda Pty Ltd

evidence.says: Apple's Mac software lookup ties com.savysoda.pixelStarships to version 1.02, released November 20, 2026.
Savy Soda lists Intel i3 and i7 processors in its Steam Mac requirements without describing the distributed executable's architectures.

limitation: The exact bundle is still listed, but its current Mach-O architecture and Rosetta status remain unverified.
notes: The version and date are for the Mac App Store channel; the Steam requirements apply to a separate distribution channel.

name: My Hospital
product: My Hospital for Mac, developed by Cherrypick Games and distributed by Kuu Hubb Oy

evidence.says: The Mac-only store listing shows version 1.2, released June 14, 2018, and identifies Kuu Hubb Oy as the seller.
Apple's Mac software lookup ties the current store version 1.2 to the exact bundle ID com.cherrypickgames.myhospitalmac.

limitation: The current Mac Store package could not be inspected and the scan in the batch covers version 1.1.33.
notes: The separately listed iOS game has its own version history.

name: HandBrakeBatch
product: HandBrakeBatch by Cesare Tagliaferri (CeMacSoft)

evidence.says: The developer says he stopped maintaining HandBrakeBatch once HandBrake implemented batch processing.
The developer's update feed lists 2.25 as its latest release and dates it February 1, 2015.
Inspection of HandBrakeBatch.app/Contents/MacOS/HandBrakeBatch in the official 2.25 ZIP found only an x86_64 Mach-O slice, while Info.plist confirmed the scanned bundle ID and version.

limitation: Rosetta operation was not verified.
notes: The upstream HandBrake project is a separate app.

name: gtkwave
product: GTKWave Logic Wave Viewer by Tony Bybell and the GTKWave project

evidence.says: The maintainers say the older prebuilt macOS LTS bundle is incompatible with current macOS and point to a community Homebrew tap and source build instructions.
Static inspection of the official zip identified bundle com.geda.gtkwave version 3.3.107 and found only an x86_64 Mach-O at gtkwave.app/Contents/MacOS/gtkwave-bin.
The separately maintained Homebrew option builds GTKWave from source on the user's machine.

limitation: The release date of the legacy Mac zip and its behavior on earlier Rosetta-capable macOS versions were not established.
notes: This assessment applies to the official prebuilt Mac bundle; the project continues and documents community installation and source-build options for newer macOS.

name: PostmanCanary
product: Postman Canary desktop prerelease channel by Postman

evidence.says: The official Canary downloads URL redirects to the standard Postman download page, which lists only the regular desktop build.
Homebrew recorded an arm64 vendor download path for its last tracked Canary build, 11.2.14-canary240621-0734, and disabled the cask because that download was no longer available.
Postman described Canary as the channel for prerelease functionality and linked to its separate download page.

limitation: Homebrew establishes the last version it tracked, and the former vendor download no longer serves an archive for independent confirmation.
notes: The last tracked Canary release had an Apple Silicon build. The regular Postman application remains a separate listing.

name: Chuzzle
product: Chuzzle Deluxe for Mac by Raptisoft and PopCap Games

evidence.says: The official Steam listing identifies the PopCap release and lists legacy G4, G5 and Intel Core Duo Mac hardware.
The compatibility project identifies the original Chuzzle Deluxe Mac executable as one of PopCap's 32-bit Intel games and requires a third-party wrapper to run it on modern Macs.
Apple confirms that macOS Catalina 10.15 and newer do not run 32-bit apps.

limitation: The exact release number of the scanned Raptisoft Mac build is unconfirmed.
notes: PopSilicon can wrap a supported original Steam copy. That workaround does not change the architecture or compatibility of the official unmodified executable.

name: Canon IJ Scan Utility2
product: Canon IJ Scan Utility2 by Canon Inc.

evidence.says: Canon lists IJ Scan Utility2 2.4.3 as its scanner utility download and names the DMG misu-mac-2_4_3-ea21_3.dmg.

Inspection of Canon IJ Scan Utility2.app/Contents/MacOS/Canon IJ Scan Utility2 in this official DMG found both arm64 and x86_64, and its plist confirmed bundle ID jp.co.canon.ij.scanutility2 and version 2.4.3.

limitation: The Canon support page gives a regional page-update date, and the original release date was not established.
notes: Canon also requires the appropriate ICA scanner driver for the device.

name: MxEasy
product: MxEasy video management software by MOBOTIX

evidence.says: MOBOTIX Japan's February 2018 product bulletin announces the end of development for MxEasy, MxControlCenter, and MxSoftPanel.
The vendor's release notes list MxEasy 1.6.1 as the last listed Mac OS X release, published September 10, 2013.
The MxEasy 1.6.1 manual specifies an Intel processor for Mac OS X.

notes: The final documented Mac release targeted Intel.

name: TriCo
product: TriCo spreadsheet-to-database conversion utility by NGUdbhav

evidence.says: NGUdbhav's GitHub release metadata dates v3.1.0 to January 22, 2023 and lists the Darwin x64 ZIP and Mac DMG as its Mac assets.
Inspection of TriCo.app/Contents/MacOS/TriCo in the release DMG found a single x86_64 slice, and the app plist reports version 3.1.0.

limitation: No firsthand Apple Silicon runtime report for this TriCo release was found.
notes: The inspected 3.1.0 bundle uses com.electron.trico in place of the scanned NGUdbhav.TriCo identifier.

name: Vector Magic
product: Vector Magic Desktop Edition by Vector Magic, Inc.

evidence.says: The vendor offers Macintosh version 1.21 as its current Desktop Edition download and says activation uses the same trial package.
The official Mac trial form serves VectorMagicSetup_mac_1_21.pkg, whose Vector Magic.app/Contents/MacOS/Vector Magic executable was inspected as universal x86_64 and arm64.

limitation: A vendor-published release date was not found.
notes: The current official package reports com.vectormagic.Vector-Magic, with a hyphen replacing the space in the older Qt bundle ID.

name: CraftManager
product: Craft Manager by InVision Labs

evidence.says: The practitioner’s setup guide identifies Craft Manager as the menu-bar companion that installs and updates the InVision Craft plugins in Sketch.
The historical app metadata ties the exact com.invisionlabs.CraftManager bundle to InVision’s Craft Manager update service.
The former official Craft download page now redirects to Miro’s homepage.

limitation: The final companion release and its architecture were not verified.
notes: The downloadable bundle managed Craft plugin installation and synchronization for InVision workflows.

name: PINManager
product: B-Trust PINManager, a smart-card PIN utility from BORICA’s B-Trust service

evidence.says: The historical bundle metadata identifies PINManager’s JavaAppLauncher and the org.btrust.cardmanager.MainClass entry point.
B-Trust’s current instructions provide a separate procedure for changing and unblocking PINs on smart cards.
The vendor offers separate Apple silicon and Intel downloads for B-TRUST BISS, its browser-signing service.
B-Trust’s linked PIN procedure names SafeNet Authentication Client Tools rather than PINManager.

limitation: No current release, architecture, or formal retirement notice could be established for the exact PINManager bundle.
notes: The newer BISS signing app and SafeNet Authentication Client are separate applications.

name: Mockuuups Studio
product: Mockuuups Studio by Mockuuups

evidence.says: The vendor's direct Apple Silicon download serves the 3.7.0 arm64 ZIP, whose Mockuuups Studio.app/Contents/MacOS/Mockuuups Studio inspected as arm64 with bundle ID com.mockuuups.studio-app.
Mockuuups calls the Setapp distribution a version of its desktop app.
Setapp currently lists version 3.9.1 and does not specify its executable architecture.

limitation: The arm64 finding applies to the vendor's direct download, and the architecture of Setapp version 3.9.1 with the scanned bundle ID remains unverified.
notes: Retain the distribution distinction when updating the listing.

name: MRIcron
product: MRIcron by Chris Rorden and the University of South Carolina Neuroimaging Lab

evidence.says: The stable release tag includes MRIcron_macOS_UniversalM1.dmg, uploaded on December 10, 2020.
Inspection of MRIcron.app/Contents/MacOS/MRIcron in the UniversalM1 disk image found both arm64 and x86_64 Mach-O slices, and Info.plist confirmed com.mricro.MRIcron.
The project marks the newer 1.2.20211006 GitHub release as a prerelease.

notes: The version date is for the universal asset, which was added to the older stable tag. The 1.2.20211006 prerelease Mac executable also inspected as universal.

name: Candle
product: Candle, Denis Gorshkov’s open-source GRBL controller and G-code viewer

evidence.says: The uploaded bundle names its executable Candle and carries the Qt/QMake-generated identifier com.yourcompany.Candle.
The historical upstream Qt/QMake project sets the application target to Candle.
A contemporaneous Mac build write-up identifies the Qt Candle application as Denvi’s GRBL controller.
The current official 11.11 release explicitly introduces native Apple silicon macOS builds.
GitHub release metadata gives the November 21, 2026 release date and lists candle-11.11-macos-arm64.dmg alongside the x64 DMG.

limitation: The old bundle used a generic Qt identifier, so historic identity is corroborated by the matching app target and build system rather than a vendor-specific bundle ID.
notes: The product is the Qt CNC control app by Denvi, which ships separate Apple silicon and Intel disk images.

name: E-Mage Reloaded
product: E-Mage Reloaded by Benjamin Montazer

evidence.says: The submitted bundle identifies E-Mage Reloaded 0.0.2 as com.electron.emage-angular and credits Benjamin Montazer.
Douglas Junior's separate E-Mage project published its identically numbered 0.0.2 release in September 2018.

limitation: No developer release page or current binary for Benjamin Montazer's E-Mage Reloaded was found.
notes: A shared E-Mage name and version number are insufficient to apply Douglas Junior's release data to this bundle.

name: EndpointConnect
product: Check Point Endpoint Security VPN for macOS

evidence.says: Check Point documents the E89.x Endpoint Security VPN Mac client and its disk image but gives no CPU architecture for the client executable.
The current E89.x requirements name E89.40 for macOS 27 and E89.20 for macOS 26 without identifying their Mach-O slices.
Check Point explicitly required Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon for the older E84.70 release.

limitation: The CPU architecture of the current standalone client could not be verified, and the E84.70 Rosetta requirement applies to that historical release.
notes: Check Point also distributes the broader Endpoint Security suite with a Remote Access VPN feature.

name: Shift
product: Shift desktop app, now MediaSilo Desktop, by Shift Media and EditShare

evidence.says: EditShare confirms that the shift.io app was rebranded to MediaSilo in 2022.
The official desktop download offers a Mac disk image alongside separate Windows and mobile options.
The current vendor download responds with the attachment mediasilo-1.27.0-mac.dmg.

limitation: The vendor does not publish the Mac executable architecture, and the official 1.27.0 disk image exceeds the audit's inspection size limit.
notes: The similarly named Shift browser in the suggested Homebrew cask is a different product.

name: Lightworks
product: Lightworks video editor by LWKS Software

evidence.says: LWKS says Lightworks 2026.1 runs on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs with macOS Monterey 12 or later.
The technical specifications list both Intel 64-bit and Apple M-series ARM64 CPUs as supported Mac hardware.
Homebrew lists a single 2026.1.2 Mac disk image on the LWKS CDN without architecture-specific URLs.

limitation: The sources establish Apple Silicon compatibility without specifying the actual executable slices, and the 2026.1.2 disk image exceeds the audit's inspection size limit.

name: NewTek NDI Access Manager
product: NDI Access Manager for macOS by NewTek and NDI (Vizrt Group)

evidence.says: NDI distributes Access Manager as a user-facing Mac app in the NDI Tools suite.
The Access Manager page lists Intel and Apple M-series processors in the NDI Tools system requirements.
NDI Tools 6.4 is the current suite download and includes Access Manager.

limitation: The vendor does not document the version or architecture of the individual Access Manager executable, and the combined Mac package exceeds the audit's inspection size limit.
notes: NDI Tools 6.4 is the suite version.

name: Overflow
product: Overflow user-flow diagramming app by Protoio (Overflow.io)

evidence.says: The official Mac download page advertises Apple Silicon support, and its download markup links Overflow-3.5.410.dmg.
The vendor documents the nearby 3.5.405 release without specifying the desktop executable architecture.
The matching Homebrew cask points to the vendor's 3.5.405 Mac disk image and lists one URL for all Macs.

limitation: The vendor does not say whether the executable is native or translated, and the current disk image exceeds the audit's inspection size limit.
notes: The Stunt Software app in the overflow cask is unrelated. An osx_64 URL path alone does not establish the payload architecture.

name: AMC CTRL 5.15C OSX
product: AMC CTRL 5.15C OSX (vendor unidentified)

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies a macOS application bundle and executable named AMC_CTRL_5_15C_OSX without giving a vendor identifier.

limitation: No vendor, product purpose, public distribution or current architecture could be established from the bundle ID, names or version strings.
notes: The historical metadata has build number 5.15.3 and display version 1.0.0.

name: TftpServer
product: TftpServer by Fabrizio La Rosa (FlrSoft)

evidence.says: The developer's archived TftpServer help identifies version 3.6.1 and discusses Mac OS X compatibility through the Sierra and High Sierra era.
The original scan records the com.FlrSoft.TftpServer bundle ID and Intel code in the earlier 3.5.1 build.

limitation: The architecture and Rosetta behavior of 3.6.1 could not be confirmed from the developer's surviving documentation and downloads.
notes: TftpServer is a graphical front end for the TFTP service shipped with older versions of macOS.

name: Winamax Poker
product: Legacy Winamax Poker Mac desktop client by Winamax (Adobe AIR edition)

evidence.says: The historical 6.15.2 scan identifies the wam-prefixed bundle and reports an x86 executable for the copy scanned.
In the support thread, a Winamax representative directs a Mac user to reinstall Winamax together with Adobe AIR.
A Winamax team announcement dated 2020 introduces a separately rebuilt Mac client and links to its Electron installer.
The vendor still serves a legacy AIR archive whose HTTP Last-Modified header is September 2015.

limitation: The current distribution or support status of the exact 6.15.2 bundle, and whether it runs on Apple Silicon, could not be verified.
notes: The 6.15.2 version refers to the historical scan. The rebuilt Electron client and mobile editions have different packaging.

name: AVSS
product: AVSS desktop camera client distributed by ZOSI

evidence.says: ZOSI identifies AVSS as its Mac client for ZOSI DVRs, NVRs, and IP cameras.
ZOSI’s official software page links to the AVSS 2.4.0 macOS disk image.
Static inspection of AVSS2.4.0.dmg found AVSS 2.4.0 and verified that the AVSS.app/Contents/MacOS/AVSS executable contains signed x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices.

limitation: A release date for the exact build was not found.
notes: The current signed app uses com.ansjer.avss. The old 1.7.2 scan used a placeholder Qt/Digia bundle identifier.

name: Movavi Video Converter 21 Premium
product: Movavi Video Converter for Mac by Movavi (scanned as Movavi Video Converter 21 Premium)

evidence.says: Movavi's Mac changelog records version 21.5 and version 24.6.0 in the same product lineage and dates 24.6.0 to November 23, 2026.
Movavi's installer configuration serves Video Converter 24.6.0 with automatic architecture selection.
Binary inspection of the main Mach-O selected by Movavi Video Converter.app's Info.plist inside the 24.6.0 package found arm64, and its plist identified com.movavi.videoconverter24.

limitation: This verifies the current 24.6.0 release, while the architecture and Apple Silicon runtime behavior of the historical 21 Premium installer remain unverified.
notes: The app's versioned bundle ID changed from com.movavi.videoconverter21 to com.movavi.videoconverter24 in the same Movavi changelog. Version 21 Premium is an older license entitlement, and the native release may require a paid major-version upgrade.
